accessibility.contrast_ratio: APCA high contrast dark mode standard
accessibility.aria_labels: All game controls and tiles must provide clear descriptive aria-label and data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all 5 Originals (Dice, Limbo, Mines, Keno, Plinko) adopt this unified Stake-style tactile 3D theme.
Implement tactile 3D bevels on Keno and Mines tiles with realistic upper highlight borders and lower inset shadows.
Always render the glowing Big Win Pop-Up Overlay card over the active board whenever payout > 0 or multiplier >= 1.5x.
Use data-testid on all key interactive elements and inputs for automated verification.
Maintain high contrast for all numbers and hit/miss statuses.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: Do not use transparent background without backdrop filters for floating panels.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.motion: Add micro-interactions and tactile active press states for all game buttons.
